final: SELECT SUM(total) AS sum_of_state_totals, AVG(cnt) AS avg_invoices_per_state FROM (SELECT c.State AS st, SUM(i.Total) AS total, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM Invoice i JOIN Customer c ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId WHERE i.InvoiceDate >= '2010-06-22 00:00:00' AND i.InvoiceDate <= '2012-06-26 00:00:00' GROUP BY c.State)
